purpose: Contract for live owner-system delegation to unattended Second Shift. Scheduled workers do not own backlog; they consume current owner delegations and must revalidate before execution.
admission_rules: Owner path must resolve through SYSTEM-TOPOLOGY-002.json.
valid_for_control_head must equal the live canonical owner control head at revalidation time.
READY requires a concrete completion delta and stop condition.
A changed control head invalidates READY/CLAIMED until re-evaluated against the new head.
A completed or superseded objective must be removed from active_delegations before the portfolio plan is generated.
Human, author, private-data, external-authority and native-platform blockers cannot be bypassed by Second Shift.
A-01 work additionally requires a currently registered qualifier, exact subject SHA and current policy admission.
If the owner chat completes the objective during day shift, it must reconcile the delegation in the same control update: retire it, then re-evaluate whether a successor deserves delegation.
If no useful delegation exists, leave the active list empty; do not invent work merely to fill the night.

checks: verify objective remains open in current owner state
verify exact subject and qualifier for A-01 work

repair_rule: A repair that changes subject code creates a new exact SHA and a replacement delegation linked to the failed receipt/delegation. The failed delegation never silently changes subject identity.
